usage_rules.gradients: Avoid full-screen gradients. Use subtle radial gradients for spotlights only.
usage_rules.text_contrast: Ensure WCAG AA compliance. Use pure white for headings, zinc-400 for body.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-zinc-800. Active elements get border-blue-500.
visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-none for cards (flat tactical look). shadow-lg for floating actions.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-sm (Sharp, tactical feel) or rounded-md. Avoid rounded-xl.
visual_enhancers.textures: Use a subtle noise texture overlay on the background to reduce digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly. Only for sticky headers: bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-white/10.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider

inputs.style: bg-zinc-900/50 border-zinc-800 focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary rounded-sm

badges.style: bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-300 border border-zinc-700 rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider

layout.grid_system: Bento Grid. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-4.
layout.spacing: Generous padding (p-8, p-12) for marketing. Dense (p-4) for dashboard data.

motion.hover_effects: Scale up slightly (scale-105) or border glow.
motion.page_transition: Fade in with slight upward slide.

media.icons: lucide-react (default). Use Shield, Sword, Target, Zap, Activity for gamification.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is readable on dark backgrounds. Use text-zinc-400 for secondary text, not darker.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus rings (ring-2 ring-primary) are mandatory for keyboard navigation.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. UPDATE /app/frontend/src/index.css with the CSS variables defined in 'colors.palette'. Ensure .dark class is used or set :root to these dark values by default.
2. INSTALL 'lucide-react' and 'recharts' and 'framer-motion' and 'clsx' and 'tailwind-merge' if not present.
3. USE 'Barlow Condensed' for all headings (h1-h3) and 'Manrope' for body text. Add the Google Fonts link to index.html.
4. CREATE a 'Layout' component that enforces the dark theme and max-width constraints.
5. GAMIFICATION: Use 'Progress' component from shadcn for XP bars. Style it with the 'accent' color (#D9F99D).
6. CHAT: Implement the chat interface with a fixed height container, scrollable message area, and sticky input at bottom. Use 'zinc-900' for the message bubbles.
7. DASHBOARD: Use a Bento Grid layout. Top left: Level/Badge. Top Right: Streak. Center: Workout Progress.
8. NAVIGATION: Use a sidebar for desktop and a bottom nav for mobile. Icons: Home, Workouts, Nutrition, Chat, Profile.
9. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text.
Avoid 'center-everything'. Use left alignment for text to create a strong vertical axis.
Use 'gap-6' or 'gap-8' for layout spacing to let the content breathe.
Input fields should have a height of 'h-12' for better touch targets.
Toast notifications (Sonner) should be used for all success/error states.
